termination: Complete every game to first 32768 or no legal moves; no stopping according to observed wins/losses. Pause only for user cancellation or concrete runtime/safety blockers.
holdoutDefinition: These seeds have not been used in development games. No further source/option tuning during this batch.

analysis.primary: Fraction reaching 32768 among all 30 completed games
analysis.report: all outcomes, censoring, max tile distribution, scores, move counts, timing, trajectory hashes, full command/source metadata
analysis.claim: Observed proportion >= 1/3 is not proof the population probability >= 1/3. Report uncertainty and no selective exclusion.

startCondition: Both development strong pilots seed2001 and2002 have completed.
